back_notes.home.use-cases.p-5: "levanta suas placas" / "Levantar" (lit. "raises/lifts") is an unusual verb for "survey/bring up the GPUs"; meaning ambiguous.

back_notes.api-keys.p-4: Begins with 'Ele implementa' (It implements) with no antecedent; reads as fragment under a heading about leaving. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.features.dd-2: "pote de cookies" is a literal calque of "cookie jar".
